bio:
Michael is the interactive manager at FinMark Trust, bringing his expertise and experience to the team since 2016. He has been dedicated to enhancing user interactions with large datasets, employing visual cues to provide insights to decision-makers and developing digital strategies to improve financial inclusion.

With over 20 years of experience with web-based products, Michael is a problem solver who cares about crafting products and experiences that are not only useful but user-friendly and visually appealing.

His skillset involves user interactions, user experience, web-based product development, interface usability, interactive design, graphic design, multimedia design, and development. Michael holds a national diploma in graphic design from the Vaal University of Technology and multiple coding certifications.
name: Michael Dos Santos
